ai_summary: Advent Hotels International Limited announced a key leadership transition, with Mr. Rahul Pandit resigning as Managing Director & CEO effective November 1, 2026, and Mr. Himmat Singh Sandhu, a seasoned hospitality professional, appointed as his replacement. Concurrently, the Board approved a substantial increase in authorized share capital from Rs. 75.20 crores to Rs. 160 crores, which, while facilitating future capital raising for growth, implies potential equity dilution for existing shareholders.
